description: Timed silent sitting with interval bells. No goal beyond sitting quietly; the bells only mark the passage of time.
name: Void-State Sitting

phases.instruction: Sit comfortably and close your eyes. When the bell sounds, the silence begins.
phases.label: Opening

phases.instruction: Sit in silence. When the bell sounds, notice where your attention is, then let go.
phases.label: Silent sitting — bell 1 of 4

phases.instruction: Sit in silence. When the bell sounds, notice where your attention is, then let go.
phases.label: Silent sitting — bell 2 of 4

phases.instruction: Sit in silence. When the bell sounds, notice where your attention is, then let go.
phases.label: Silent sitting — bell 3 of 4

phases.instruction: Sit in silence. When the bell sounds, notice where your attention is, then let go.
phases.label: Silent sitting — bell 4 of 4

phases.instruction: The session is complete. Open your eyes slowly and return to the room.
phases.label: Closing
